name: pity
quote: Sorry for your stomach ache, but I said that candy wasn't good for you.
description: Recognizing the suffering of a person or animal but feeling it's probably their fault in some way.

variations.name: dissonant pity
variations.description: If you're not sure whether you should be warmer or help more, there may be some dissonance.
examples: I told her not to do that, but didn't know it would be that bad.

commentaries.quote: Pity is related to sympathy, but pity is cooler and more distant, so can be perceived as less friendly.

With pity, there's a sense that the person sorta deserves the suffering. With sympathy, they're innocent victims but you can only help with moral support. With compassion, you're offering more tangible help.

conditions: You recognize suffering in another but perceive it was likely caused by their own actions.
